messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1955554321 - Elevated 5xx rate for inference service in us-west-2b. Error spike started ~1955554280. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (high qps), /v1/chat (medium). Impact: ~18% 5xx across routed shards, latency +120ms. Auto-escalation to P1. Paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre (Sam): Ack. I'm on it. Pulling logs and CW metrics now.

alex_k (Platform): I'm seeing ENI detach/attach flaps from instances in the us-west-2b AZ around 1955554265-1955554300. EC2 console shows intermittent 'network interface reset' events.

maria_p (Infra): Confirming. CloudWatch logs show spike in ENI error codes (AttachFailed 1.2k) and instance network rx drops. No host cpu/mem pressure.

chris_r (Runtime): That maps to KV cache misses, lots of reconnects from runtime side. We're seeing stale KV sessions and a backlog in the request queue for GPU-backed endpoints.

support-led (Jules): Customer impact: Support dashboard shows 12 clients reporting increased failures, 3 with degraded SLAs. Not large yet but growing. Notifying account teams.

oncall-sre (Sam): Quick triage options: 1) Route traffic away from us-west-2b to other AZs/regions. 2) Force failover to cpu-only fallback for critical customers. 3) Drain affected hosts and spin replacement nodes in other AZs. Thoughts?

alex_k (Platform): Smart routing policies can shift weights by AZ. Can move 70% traffic off us-west-2b within ~60s by updating routing config. Need product signoff for cross-AZ hit to latency.

product-eng (Nina): Do it. Better to keep availability. We'll track perf regressions. Notify customers in-thread with ETA.

oncall-sre (Sam): Action: I'll start weight shift. Alex, you coordinate the routing change. Maria, begin draining unhealthy instances. Chris, prepare model fallbacks for a small canary if routing doesn't drop error rate.

alex_k (Platform): Executing routing weight adjust now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl routing update --region us-west-2 --steer-away az:us-west-2b --weight 0.1 --dry-run=false
```
Applying...

incident-bot: Routing update job submitted (job id rjoy-8442). Estimated convergence 45-90s.

maria_p (Infra): Kicking off node drains. Using policy: drain-only-infer-gpus, replace with instances in us-west-2c. Command snippet: 
```
aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0abcde... --region us-west-2
```
No autoscaling events yet, forcing replacements with warm images.

chris_r (Runtime): Starting canary fallback: cpu-encoders for top 3 affected customers. Patch available, triggering canary for 5% of their traffic. If errors persist after routing change, will expand.

oncall-sre (Sam): Monitoring 5xx rate (source: infra-metrics).

[~60s pass]

oncall-sre (Sam): 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% overall across service. us-west-2b specifically down to 4% but still above baseline 0.5%. Traffic offload achieved ~72%.

support-led (Jules): Notified affected customers: email + status page update draft ready. Posting short note to status.redwood: "We experienced increased errors in us-west-2b; routing adjusted and mitigation in progress; we'll update within 30m."

product-eng (Nina): Good. Watch for latency regressions. We'll accept small latency uptick if error rate holds.

alex_k (Platform): One of the replacement instances failed boot due to AMI mismatch; manual patch in progress. Replacements continuing, expected to finish in ~7m.

maria_p (Infra): Found the root of ENI flaps: AWS reported a transient networking firmware bug affecting a subset of Nitro hosts in us-west-2b. AWS case opened (case 987654321). They recommend moving workloads off affected hypervisors.

chris_r (Runtime): KV cache warm-up causing spikes after draining. I'm priming caches using prefetch tool: 
```
./prefetch_kv --endpoints ids.txt --warmup=hot
```
Should reduce cold-start dropout.

oncall-sre (Sam): OK, current plan: keep traffic steer in place until replacements are healthy and AWS confirms underlying host issue mitigated. Expand CPU fallback only if error rates rise. Support to post status update; engineering to continue remediation.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P1 created: PD-#4482. Primary responders: oncall-sre (Sam), alex_k, maria_p, chris_r. ETA next update in 15m.

support-led (Jules): Posted initial status. Triage channel created: #incident-1955554321-usw2b. Customer success alerted to prepare proactive outreach for top accounts.

[~8m pass]

oncall-sre (Sam): Follow-up: us-west-2b error rate steady at 3.8%. Backend retries decreased. CloudWatch shows ENI error tail off in last 4m but still occasional. AWS case updated, they are migrating VMs away from impacted rack.

alex_k (Platform): Rollback plan ready: if we see errors >6% for 5m, we will shift 100% traffic off us-west-2b and enable aggressive CPU fallback for heavy SLAs.

product-eng (Nina): Approve. Also capturing perf metrics to compare affected customers pre/post.

oncall-sre (Sam): Handoff note: I'll stay on for next 30m then hand to night oncall. Leaving runbook step list in channel. If AWS indicates full host remediation, we'll slowly bring weight back.

support-led (Jules): Escalation checklist: outreach list, refund cap calculation if SLA breached, notify sales ops.

chris_r (Runtime): Added temporary metric: kv_reconnect_rate and request_retry_count to dashboard. Will alert at 5x baseline.

incident-bot: Update scheduled: 1955554545 - automatic metric snapshot posted to #incident-1955554321-usw2b.

[final update before handoff]

oncall-sre (Sam): us-west-2b continues to be degraded but stable at sub-4% 5xx with traffic ~28%. Replacements 6/8 done. AWS says full host migration may take up to 2 hours. No further customer escalations in last 20m. Handing to night oncall; paging them now.

pagerduty-bot: Paging night-oncall.

support-led (Jules): We'll keep the status page updated hourly and create customer-specific tickets for the three highest-impact accounts.

product-eng (Nina): Post-incident actions: 1) Add routing play to runbook for faster AZ evacuation. 2) Test pre-warm cache step during drain. 3) Evaluate cross-AZ capacity alarms earlier.

oncall-sre (Sam): Thanks all. Leaving channel open, passing to night team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed for primary responders; ongoing updates in #incident-1955554321-usw2b."
